values.note: 2026, tax included: $50 a night with water and electric, $40 without; weekly (6 nights) $250 / $175; monthly (29 nights) $650 / $500. Rates may change for 2027. Paid in full on arrival; no refunds.

values.note: Reservation by request form, confirmed by email; no walk-ups. Check-in 8 a.m.-4:30 p.m. Some dates are taken by private events on the grounds.

note: Dakota County Agricultural Society campground on the fairgrounds at Farmington, open to ordinary nightly stays through the summer; some dates go to events on the grounds. Generators are not allowed and there is no storm shelter. --Claude
summary: Camping page read: 2026 season May 1 - Sep 25; reservation-only by request form, 2-night minimum; $50 W/E / $40 dry, tax included, +$4 per person over 4, weekly/monthly offered; dump. Base corrected 50 -> 40 (dry site). Ordinary nights outside events confirmed. Not waterfront. Google 4.5/869 (whole fairgrounds).
flags: FAIRGROUNDS TEST passed: the Agricultural Society sells ordinary nights all season (May 1 - Sep 25, 2026) outside the fair, by reservation request; 'dates that we are full ... when the fairgrounds are booked by private events'.

LONG-STAY: weekly ($250) and monthly ($650) rates are offered beside the nightly rate; the share of monthly campers could not be measured (no inventory published). 2-night minimum all season (under the 3-night drop line).

Base fee corrected 50 -> 40: the site without water/electric ($40, tax included) takes a 23-ft motorhome ('Campsites are limited to: one RV, or one travel trailer, or one pop-up camper'). Private-gate check: both rates include sales tax, so even $50 is under $50 before tax.

OWNERSHIP question: the operator is the Dakota County Agricultural Society (a county agricultural society, not the county government; copyright 'Dakota County Agricultural Society'). Stored ownership 'local'; reviewer may prefer 'private'.
Google Maps: 'Dakota County Fairgrounds' 4.5 stars / 869 reviews (the whole fairgrounds, not the campground), phone +1 651-463-8818.
Hookups/sites/showers: the page does not state amperage, a site count, pull-throughs or showers; stored values (50 A, ~100 sites, pull-through, showers) left as they are, unconfirmed.
Phone: stored 651-463-8818 confirmed (camping contact; email camping@dakotacountyfair.org).
